parts:
Hi all,

Apologies for posting on another R package here, although I was introduced to Stereomorph through a geomorph workshop and the author is no longer taking questions, so I hope that's ok.

I'm trying to convert tps files to shape files using the TPSToShapes function, but I'm getting the below error. 
> ldmks <- c(1:19)
> TPSToShapes(tps.file='Verts.tps', shapes.file='Shapes', image.file='Images',
+             landmark.names=ldmks, scaling.units='mm', flip.y = TRUE)
Error in lm_arr[jj, , kk] <- as.numeric(strsplit(read_lines[ii], " ")[[1]]) :
  replacement has length zero
The dataset is 21 images of vertebrae with 19 landmarks. The right side is mirrored so could be slightly off, however the idea is to adjust them in stereomorph and compare. 

I attach the images and tps file here, thanks so much if someone could help me!

Christy
